prompt_sentence: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

notes.prefill_range: The fork prefills ids[:-1], chunked by max_chunk_size and aligned down to PAGE_SIZE, then cuts a recurrent model at the last page boundary (generator/job.py). The last prompt token is a decode forward.
notes.last_block: Layer 63 is the last KV module. prefill_ls sets params['prefill'] only there (model/model_ls.py). TransformerBlock.forward runs the mixer, then returns the incoming residual and skips the MLP (modules/transformer.py). That digest equals layer 62. Final norm and lm_head do not run during prefill.
notes.cache_width: cache_tokens is 12288 so the 8400-token job's 33 pages fit, and so does a decode table padded out to 48. The serve default is 270336. Prefill num_splits follows the job allocation ceil((prompt_len + max_new_tokens + 1) / 256), which is constant for every chunk. 8190 is 32 pages (div16) and 8400 is 33 (other); one prompt cannot hit both page classes. Decode num_splits follows the current sequence length padded up to a multiple of 16.
notes.residual_digest: blake2b-256 of the little-endian fp32 bytes of the block return, shape [1, n, 5120], for that prefill chunk.
notes.attn_digest: blake2b-256 of used rows in logical block-table order. Page p uses physical index block_table[p], rows min(256, tokens_written - 256*p). tokens_written is prompt_len - 1. qk and qv are int32, sk and sv fp16. The tail of a partial page is not included.
notes.gdn_digest: blake2b-256 of the job slot. conv_state[slot] is bf16 (raw 16-bit pattern); recurrent_state[slot] is fp32. max_batch_size is 1 and max_history is 0, so the slot is the live state.
notes.logits: fp16 row returned by model.forward on the last prompt token, cloned before the sampler. The .bin file is that row, little-endian.
